name: ISPX
summary: ISP that succeeded DoveNetQ (Uniting Church ISP) ~2012; brand later shown by Planet Ozi (2018) (operated by PLANET OZI PTY LTD, ACN 108 139 037).

events.details: Acquired by Planet Ozi Pty Ltd.

refs.label: By 28 Dec 2018 the ISPX home host had been 301-redirected into planetozi.com.au, showing the brand had been absorbed by Planet Ozi.
ISPX (successor to DoveNetQ ~2012) was still itself in 2012-2013 before the later Planet Ozi absorption.
